notes.title: Speedway Ringer v1.607
notes.content:
Enhanced determinism applied to the physics model, making lap-to-lap feel more consistent.
 Increased grip on the outside of Steele Creek

notes.title: Speedway Ringer v1.606
notes.content:
Netcode improvements
 
 Horsepower increased slightly

 Server browser appears to be working as expected

notes.title: Speedway Ringer v1.605
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the loading screen wouldn't collapse after leaving a session.

notes.title: v1.604
notes.content:
Catch fence models are now nanite (virtualized geometry system which uses a new internal mesh format and rendering technology to render pixel scale detail) meshes, which will definitely improve performance

 Dynamic Global Illumination has been disabled for now in exchange for massive scalability improvements


IMPORTANT: If you had issues running the game before this build, give it another shot and let me know if it helps.

notes.title: Speedway Ringer 1.602/1.603
notes.content:
Dynamic track model sensitivity has been reduced significantly to avoid the feeling of plowing when the track gets hot
 Added the ability to spawn after missing the grid from pit road (you won't receive a UI though, we'll work on fixing that.)
 Increased grid countdown from 15 to 30 seconds
 You can now spawn on the grid after the countdown from 5 starts. I'm face palming as I type this.
 Created the ability to flip your car back over your car by hitting Y on Xbox (top face button) or F on the keyboard. You can do this once every 4 seconds. Otherwise people fly 5000 feet into the air when the spam it (might be fun). 
 Netcode should use more interpolation, so you should see far less lag and smoother movement for cars.
 Updated network smoothing - if cars are in the incorrect position on track, they should more smoothly correct back to their last known position. 
 Slightly adjusted horsepower
 Slightly adjusted tire grip
 Slightly adjusted maximum slip angle (the car will skew slightly less in the corners)
 Adjusted camera angle slightly (closer to the car, less lag, smaller FOV)
 Changed how sessions are destroyed when a server goes offline, and when a driver leaves a session. This should cause fewer issues when refreshing the server browser and having old sessions appear when they are no longer online. I'm not sure if this is going to entirely fix the issue, but we'll get this fixed 100% soon

notes.title: V 1.601
notes.content: Dynamic track model sensitivity has been greatly increased.

notes.title: v1.598 Build
notes.content:
Textures are more scalable for lower end PCs.

 Bird volume has been adjusted.

 Lap counter should display for all clients for online races.

 Camera angle and altitude has been adjusted so players can look further forward.

notes.title: v1.597
notes.content:
Players are less likely to get stuck when loading an online session if connection fails

 Remote clients are more likely to see the lap counter in the top right of the screen during the race session

 Reduced the maximum steering angle from 22 to 19 degrees
